description: Merge two arrays into one. Optionally extract values by property path from each array before combining.
label: Array Combine

options.name: pathA
options.label: Path A
options.info: Dot-separated path to a property on each item in Array A to extract before combining. Omit to use items as-is.

options.name: pathB
options.label: Path B
options.info: Dot-separated path to a property on each item in Array B to extract before combining. Omit to use items as-is.

options.name: schema
options.label: Schema Model
options.info: Schema model for the output array type.

options.name: model
options.label: Model for output
options.info: Use this if you want to type the output to a model

options.name: result
options.label: Output
options.info: The combined array, typed to the selected Schema Model.

options.name: resultModel
options.label: Output: Model
options.info: The combined array, typed to the selected Model.
